exposure: intakes of aquatic products and mutton
outcome: plasma concentrations of 15 essential and toxic elements (Zn, Cr, Mo, Ni, Sb, Cd, Pb, Cu, I, Al, Hg, Fe, Mn)
cohort: 1211 healthy pregnant and lactating women from coastland, lakeland, and inland areas of China
finding: Concentrations of essential and toxic elements in pregnant and lactating women varied by physiologic stage, region, and were associated with maternal socio-demographic characteristics and dietary factors.
mod_finding: Concentrations of some elements differed according to mode of delivery.
